opportunities.title: Small Grants – UK
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution willing to receive grant funds. Applications are not accepted from individuals seeking support for personal projects, though the UK office may consider individuals with organisational support. Open to any field including arts and culture, humanities, Japanese language, medicine and health, science, youth and education, sport.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding for projects that bring UK and Japan together, fostering mutual understanding, exchange of ideas, or lasting collaboration across a wide range of sectors.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health

amount.raw: Up to £10,000 per year, up to £30,000 total for multi‑year projects

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants are researchers, practitioners, policy makers, managers or voluntary sector workers in health who can demonstrate UK‑Japan collaboration. Preference for those without prior UK‑Japan collaboration and early‑career applicants.
opportunities.summary: Supports exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK, covering scientific, clinical, social and economic issues in healthcare.
